info.description: Actual responses from dedicated FieldOps sandbox fixtures, captured through direct live API requests on October 8, 2026. Original full workflow was also tested manually in Apidog. These examples are historical snapshots; mutations require the current resource state/version. Never run the entire collection automatically. Authentication secrets are redacted; store real values only in Local Values. This folder complements the canonical API documentation. Administration responses were captured manually in Apidog after deployment of de6d649. Apidog may group requests sharing a method/path into one endpoint with multiple cases; the JSON retains each scenario.
